messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT SEV2: Detected gradual memory creep in kv-cache on prod-gpu-07. Patterns: slow RSS growth over ~6h, multiple CUDA OOMs on runtime v2.7. Pager notify sent to @oncall.

oncall: I'm oncall for the shift, joining. grabbing initial logs and grafana.
alex: logged in, tailing runtime logs. seeing repeated: "allocator: paged fragment > 95% but no compaction triggered" then CUDA OOMs around 1:02am.
maria: customer-impact: a few customers reported 503s on long-context requests (~64k tokens). looks limited to large-seq routes.
sam: quick dump: /var/log/runtime/oom.log snippet:
```
[01:02:14] runtime panic: cuda out of memory
[01:02:14] stack: allocator->paged::alloc -> kv_cache::fetch_page -> runtime::gen_step
[01:03:00] compaction job failed: device busy
```
jordan: could be fragmentation + compaction starvation. maybe compaction job isn't getting scheduled under high infer load.
oncall: can we evict a percentage of kv cache on that node to buy time? what are downsides?
maria: evicting frees pages but will increase cold hits and latency for requests that rely on cached prefixes. customers on long contexts may see higher latency or transient 5xx if retry logic isn't robust.
alex: we have an admin endpoint to evict: POST /admin/kv/evict?percent=30 — I can trigger for prod-gpu-07 if we agree.
sam: also saw container restart doesn't clear device memory immediately in our infra; need to restart the cuda container + ensure driver cleaned.
oncall: infra-bot, can you cordon prod-gpu-07 and stop new pods being scheduled there?
infra-bot: Action: cordon node prod-gpu-07 (kubeadm/prod). Pod evictions allowed: yes.
jordan: plan: 1) trigger 30% kv evict on node to drop working set, 2) kick compaction job to run immediately, 3) if OOMs continue, drain node and restart runtime container (ensure driver reset).
maria: +1 on plan. notify support for proactive customer messages for affected routes.
oncall: alex — please run evict now and start compaction job. I'll monitor for new OOMs.
alex: evict POST sent: /admin/kv/evict?node=prod-gpu-07&percent=30 -> 202 accepted.
alex: compaction job triggered: job/id=compaction-1738884444 started.
oncall: watching metrics: mem usage dropped ~28% within 45s. token throughput steady.
sam: running cc: allocator debug shows compaction scanning freed segments, reclaiming 22% of pages. no more immediate OOMs in last 6m.
jordan: we should keep compaction frequency bumped for next 2h. also open a follow-up to root cause the compaction starvation.
maria: raising customer notice: support DM template ready. will send to affected accounts if new errors show.
oncall: good. leaving node cordoned until we confirm stability for 30m. if memory resumes upward trend, escalate to full node drain and runtime restart.
alex: documenting commands used in incident log.
infra-bot: Note: cordon active; drain scheduled if requested.
oncall: follow-up tasks: create runbook PR to automate emergency partial-evict + compaction trigger, add alert for compaction-failures. assigning to sam/jordan.
sam: assigned, will start a postmortem and link traces.
maria: will coordinate customer comms if needed.
oncall: thanks team — keeping this thread open. :thumbsup:
